evals.name: detailed-issue-checklist
evals.prompt: Draft only the issue description for a plain-language Terraform plan report. Goal: developers should understand planned cloud changes without cloud expertise. Tasks: explain what each service enables and flag access questions for platform review; exclude secrets, credentials, raw state and unrestricted plan values; publish one MR comment for all selected projects and prevent older pipelines from replacing newer reports; show exact plan facts when AI is unavailable. No required template. Do not post, use tools or add attribution. Use only the supplied facts.
evals.expected_output: A concise issue with detailed checklist items that are easy to scan by outcome.
assertions: The issue states the user problem and wanted result without implementation history
Each detailed task is a checkbox item
Each detailed task starts with a short bold outcome followed by a period
The explanation after each bold outcome preserves the supplied scope or constraint
The body contains no invented facts
